description: Hausjärven ja Lopen sähköisten palveluiden ja asianhallinnan kehittämishanke is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Hausjärvi. Material produced in the e-services and case management project, including municipal surveys, an overview of case management, a case management and e-services metrics base, and guidance on the use of MS Forms by municipalities. Coverage: Hausjärvi. The portal shows the English title as "Hausjärvi and Lope electronic services and case management development project" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Hausjärvi. Its keywords include asianhallinta, sähköinen asiointi. The listing shows 5 download or service links in PDF, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
